reasoning: Base ratings: the Pacers are -5.7 and the Wizards -7.3 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Pacers 4.0 better here, total 226.
Rest, travel and availability move it 0.7 towards the Wizards.
The psychological spots lean 0.3 towards the Pacers.
Bottom line: Pacers by 3.6, 60% to win; total 226 (80% range 203-250).
